maxResultBytes.meaning: Largest structuredContent of the tool result

refreshTimeoutMs.meaning: Time before a refresh with no result fails

defaultHeightPx.meaning: Chart height when the element height is 0

defaultFrom.meaning: from when the tool arguments have none

defaultTo.meaning: to when the tool arguments have none

defaultMaxDataPoints.meaning: maxDataPoints of a query that has none. intervalMs is the range divided by it

maxSeries.meaning: Most series that the Renderer draws

maxBundleGzipBytes.meaning: Largest gzip size of the Renderer bundle. Not set until the host size research is done

maxAppNotes.meaning: Most notes of the Source that render_grafana_app adds to its text line

maxAppNoteChars.meaning: Longest note in the text line of render_grafana_app

maxTitleChars.meaning: Longest title of the tool arguments

deprecationDays.meaning: Shortest deprecation period of a change to a frozen interface

specVersion.meaning: The viz spec version that this contract gives
